Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 136. Category: technique. Rank 1.

Rank 1 Ki technique
Ki Cost: 8
Prerequisites: none
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: 15 cone
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
Type: Barrage
Fire numerous small ki blasts in close range. All
targets in range must make a Dexterity saving throw or
take 2d12 ki damage, half on a successful save.
